neutrality_claim: Ordinary library for consumer-owned contribution contracts. Contract identity, payload meaning and trusted payload validators remain with the consuming extension-point owner. The package has no product, Get Modular, Live Module Updates, Node adapter, credential or Host policy dependency.
release_policy: Private pre-1.0 0.0.0 qualification under ADR-0016, with an independent replacement or release lifecycle. Public npm publication is deferred and must reverify immutable package evidence through the applicable publication gate.
